description: Check an active monitor's page now instead of waiting for its schedule. The check runs in monity.ai's cloud browser and takes up to a minute or two; then get_latest_result shows it. Counts against the plan like any check. Resume a paused monitor first. For a page monitor, pass waitSeconds to hold this call until the check has ended and get its result in the same answer: do that when the user wants to know what the page shows now. Without it the answer carries askedAt, and a get_latest_result result is this check's only when it was created at or after that time. If a check was already running, none is started: that one began before the request, and its result says so.

waitSeconds.description: Page monitors: hold the call until the check has ended and answer its result, at most 50 seconds (default 0: answer at once)

name: run_monitor
title: Run a check now
